Name: Lewd Chinese Bachelorettes
Author: IJustWantTheNudes
Description:
This adds new portraits for Abigail, Penny, Haley and Leah with some redone faces and extra cleavage.
You may want to download the Chinese portrait pack first as it includes more of the townspeople and then just replace these 4.

I just wanted to take the nice portraits found [url=http://bbs.3dmgame.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=5058948]here[/url]﻿ and use them with AirplaneRandy's [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/lewd-bachelorettes-portrait-mod-buxom-haley-added.108210/]Lewd Bachelorettes[/url]﻿. All I did myself was combine the portrait art and I redrew some of it.
I do not have either of the original creators permission and will take it down if they should complain.

Place the Portraits folder in SteamLibrary\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content or wherever your Stardew directory is.
